triples.head: mycorrhizae
triples.evidence: In a mycorrhizal association, the fungal mycelia use their extensive network of hyphae and large surface area in contact with the soil to channel water and minerals from the soil into the plant.

triples.head: plants
triples.evidence: In exchange, the plant supplies the products of photosynthesis to fuel the metabolism of the fungus.
